text: A mournful and sad classical piece for solo piano, featuring a slow tempo and a 4/4 time signature. The melody is composed of long, flowing phrases in a minor key, spanning 12 ~ 16 bars and lasting about 45 seconds, evoking a sense of deep solitude.

This sad classical composition features a somber string quartet arrangement. It has a very slow pace, characterized by dissonant harmonies and a narrow pitch range of 3 octaves. The piece spans 8 ~ 10 bars and plays for approximately 30 seconds.

A hauntingly sad classical track with a 3/4 time signature, reminiscent of a funeral march. The music uses a low register and heavy chordal textures, progressing over 20 bars with a total runtime of 60 seconds.

This track is a sad classical adagio with a delicate and fragile melody. The rhythm is steady but slow, spanning 5 octaves to create a wide, airy soundscape. It plays for about 40 seconds across 14 bars.

A melancholic and sad classical solo cello piece. It features a rubato rhythm that feels hesitant and emotional. The music stays within a 2-octave range, focusing on the deep, resonant tones of the instrument for 15 bars and 35 seconds.

This sad classical piece employs a polyphonic texture with overlapping minor-key melodies. It has a moderate-slow tempo and a 4/4 time signature, spanning 18 bars and lasting 50 seconds, creating an atmosphere of quiet despair.
A brief but intensely sad classical interlude, featuring sharp, staccato notes in a high register that sound like weeping. The piece is compact, spanning 6 ~ 8 bars and playing for just 20 seconds.

This sad classical music is characterized by a descending melodic line and a very soft dynamic level. It uses a major-key variation that still feels bittersweet and nostalgic, spanning 12 bars over 30 seconds.

A dramatic and sad classical orchestral segment with high rhythmic intensity but a slow, dragging pulse. It spans 5 octaves and features a dense harmonic structure, playing for 55 seconds across 16 bars.

This song is a minimalist and sad classical arrangement. It focuses on a repeating, simple rhythmic motif in a 6/8 time signature, creating a hypnotic and sorrowful effect over 24 bars and 45 seconds.
